scope: New structured step tasks with explicit approved constraints. Any satisfying plan accepted. Model does not extract authoritative constraints from prose. Fixed first pass versus one host-feedback repair; not H2 learning or live avatar execution.

cases.request: The root begins at x=-200 mm and must finish at x=200 mm. Keep the pelvis within [-400, 400] mm throughout. The first and fourth moves go right; the second move uses a clear accent. Choose the other details so the endpoint is reached.
Starting at the center, finish at the center without letting the pelvis leave the -200 to 200 mm lane. Go right, immediately return left, then take another left step and finish with a right step.
From x=400 mm, return to x=0 while staying between -400 and 400 mm. Step left on the first and third moves; accent the opening softly and the last move clearly.

Draft: start with a right step and finish left. Correction: the opening is left and soft, and the final step is right with a clear accent. Return to x=0 from x=0, keeping the pelvis within -400 to 400 mm; choose the two middle steps to make that work.
Begin at -400 mm and end at the center, never crossing outside the -400 to 400 mm root lane. The opening move goes right, the last move goes left, and move two has a clear accent.
Start at 200 mm and end at -200 mm, staying inside [-400, 400] mm. Use left, right, left for moves one, three, and four; make the third move soft. Fill the remaining direction to hit the endpoint.
From center, return to center within the narrow -200 to 200 mm lane. The first step is right and the fourth is left. Make both middle accents clear; select their order so the root stays in the lane.
Begin at -200 mm and finish at +200 mm, with the pelvis always inside [-400, 400] mm. Take a left step second and a right step fourth; make moves one and three soft.
Starting at 0 mm, reach exactly 200 mm in four moves of 200 mm each, with the root kept between -400 and 400 mm. Any left/right sequence is allowed.
From 0 mm, finish at +800 mm after four steps while the pelvis remains in the lane from -600 to +600 mm. No move directions are preselected.
Start and finish at 0 mm, keeping the pelvis in the lane [0, 200] mm. The first two moves must both go right; choose either direction for moves three and four.
From 0 mm, end at +400 mm inside the -800 to 800 mm lane. The complete sequence is fixed: left-soft, right-clear, left-soft, right-clear.
